name: eevee-viewport-aov-through-transmission
purpose: Verify that Eevee rendered viewport keeps view-layer AOV buffers available for material NPR AOV Input nodes when a ray-traced transmissive foreground layer reads AOV data from the layer behind it.
passCriteria: A child Blender viewport opens the repro scene, captures a rendered camera viewport, and the foreground transmissive region that reads the behind-object AOV must be visibly non-black while a normal Eevee render of the same scene also remains non-black.
